page.layout: Running head at top: page number "224" at left, title "PROMPTV. ICONVM" at right. Below it, two round medallion portraits side by side, each with inscription around its rim. Below them, one block of text in two paragraphs, full width. At the foot, a woodcut ornament without text.

main_text.p: IOANNES Iacobus Triuu[?]lfius Mediolanensis, Franciæ Marefchalus seu Tribunus, ac præfectus militum Fracię in Italia, deuicta Alexandria Ludouicum Sfortiam Mediolano expu-lit, ac deinde Nouarra: quamobrem à Fracorum Rege cui erat addictissimus, Mediolano præficitur anno Domini 1499. Postea Lugdunum Galliæ rexit, vbi diligentissimè, atque accuratissimè præfuit anno Domini 1514. Ceterum Carnuti obiit non sine omnium planctu, ob synceram eius administrationè, anno ætatis 8o. iussitque corpus suum Mediolani sepeliendum deferri.

THEODORVS Triuulfius Marchio Picichitoni præfectus militum Regis Neapolitani, deinde Dux exercitus Venetorum ac Florentinorum, postea Eques ordinis à Francisco Valesio creatus, Mediolano præficitur: tandémq; Marefchalus, siue Tribunus militum ab eodem designatus, Lugduni præfuit: vbi summa fide, ac vigilantia, re administrata, eodem quo natus fuerat die obiit septuagenario maior, anno à Christo nato 1533.

page.notes: Medallion inscriptions transcribed as printed; the first letters of "TRIVLZIVS" and the left-hand "TRIVL." are partly worn and uncertain. "Triuulfius" in the first paragraph is only partly legible, marked [?]. The woodcut ornament at the foot carries no text.
